description: For a multi-item request, collect p2209_id and any selected variation_id from global_search results and send all selected items in one call. For every variable product, include a variation_id from its selected variants_compact entry on the first call; without it the price and basket total may be unknown. Never substitute WooCommerce numeric product IDs for p2209_id. Set live=false for a snapshot-only check with no merchant request; live=true reads merchants. Checks a basket of offers (up to 40 lines, any merchants) against the merchants' own data. Per line: variant_selected, available, quantity (declared stock) and price_unchanged (pass expected_unit_price), each true / false / unknown with evidence. Per merchant: subtotal, declared shipping options for the destination computed on that merchant's basket subtotal (free-shipping threshold, amount missing), and the exact checkout-session request (endpoint + body) to send to the merchant ONLY after the user decides. KaliCart creates no session and no order; totals are estimates and the merchant checkout is the only authority.

destination.description: ISO 3166-1 country, optionally with region: "IT" or "IT:CB". Needed for shipping.

expected_unit_price.description: The unit price you showed the user; checked as price_unchanged.

variation_id.description: For a variable product, pass the chosen variant ID from global_search variants_compact; required to price that line and compute a complete basket total.

live.description: false (default) uses saved Global data without contacting merchants; true reads each merchant now (at most 10 lines).

name: verify_basket
title: Verify a multi-merchant basket before handing it to checkout
